sql: select 'fill' k, f.market_ticker, f.filled_at::text t, o.action||' '||o.side||' lim '||o.limit_price||' fill '||f.side||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity v from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-22 15:40' union all select 'chg', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,status) from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-10-22 15:40' union all select 'nqe', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE' and action='buy' union all select 'nqeq', 'held', '', (select sum(f.quantity)::text from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and o.market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTIONB-26OCT27-NQE' and o.action='buy') union all select 'open', market_ticker, created_at::text, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||status from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and status in ('resting','partial','submitted') order by 1,3
